summary.text: Robin Titus is a Republican state senator from Nevada who has represented District 17 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; she is a physician who earlier served in the Nevada State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Titus lives in Wellington, Nevada, and graduated from Smith Valley High School in 1972.
She earned a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering in 1976 and a doctorate in medicine in 1981, both from the University of Nevada, Reno.
Her career experience includes working as a physician with the South Lyon Medical Center, as a health officer with Lyon County and as the emergency medical director of the Smith Valley Fire District.
Titus represented Assembly District 38 from 2014 to 2022 and took office in the Senate on November 9, 2022.
In the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Education, Finance, and Health and Human Services.
